license.title: Offline license
license.description: Enter the signed EAI license key. Validation is performed locally and does not require an internet connection.

data_description.license_key: The license key starts with EAI1. and is issued by your EAI provider.

heat_pump.title: Heat pump and building
heat_pump.description: Enter the technical details of the heat pump and its installation.

data_description.wp_type: Select the heat source and system type.
data_description.heating_capacity_kw: Rated heat output according to the data sheet, from 1 to 100 kW.
data_description.cop_rated: Rated coefficient of performance according to the data sheet, from 1 to 10.
data_description.has_heating_element: Enable this if the system has an electric auxiliary heater.
data_description.has_dhw: Enable this if the heat pump also provides domestic hot water.
data_description.building_ref: Optional name used to identify the building, for example Residential house.

required_sensors.title: Required sensors
required_sensors.description: Assign the three measurements required for the basic EAI functions.

data_description.wp_power_entity: Expected: sensor for the heat pump's current total electrical power input. Unit: W. Required.
data_description.wp_energy_today: Expected: electrical energy meter accumulated daily since 00:00 that resets to 0 at midnight. Unit: kWh. Required.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current outdoor air temperature at the building. Unit: °C. Required.

standard_sensors.title: Standard sensors
standard_sensors.description: Assign available operating and temperature sensors. All fields on this page are optional.

data_description.indoor_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in a representative indoor or reference room. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.target_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the currently configured room target temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.operation_mode_entity: Expected: sensor with a stable text state for the operating mode, such as heating, domestic hot water, defrost, or off. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.compressor_entity: Expected: binary sensor for compressor operation (on/off) or numerical sensor using 1/0. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.dhw_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.flow_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current heating circuit flow temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.return_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current return temperature of the same heating circuit. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.starts_entity: Expected: cumulative compressor-start counter; counter resets must be detectable. Unit: count. Optional.
data_description.runtime_entity: Expected: cumulative compressor runtime counter. Unit: h. Optional.

advanced_sensors.title: Advanced sensors
advanced_sensors.description: Assign additional measurements for advanced analysis. All fields on this page are optional.

data_description.thermal_energy_entity: Expected: cumulative heat meter for thermal energy delivered by the heat pump; the system boundary for space heating and domestic hot water must be known. Unit: thermal kWh. Optional.
data_description.volume_flow_entity: Expected: sensor for the current heating circuit volume flow; the fluid and measured circuit must be known. Unit: l/min or m³/h. Optional.
data_description.source_temp_entity: Expected: heat-source temperature sensor for outdoor air, brine, or groundwater. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.storage_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the buffer or domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.

wallbox_choice.title: E-mobility and wallbox
wallbox_choice.description: Enable optional wallbox analytics. EAI only creates recommendations and never sends control commands to the vehicle or wallbox.

data_description.wallbox_enabled: Enables joint planning of heat-pump demand and vehicle charging from residual PV energy.

wallbox.title: Wallbox and vehicle
wallbox.description: Assign measurements and charging targets for the primary wallbox. EAI only exposes passive advice and automation triggers.

data_description.wallbox_name: Free name for the vehicle or wallbox. Unit: none.
data_description.wallbox_power_entity: Expected: sensor for current wallbox charging power. Unit: W. Required.
data_description.wallbox_energy_today_entity: Expected: charging energy accumulated since midnight. Unit: kWh. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_connected_entity: Expected: binary sensor indicating that a vehicle is connected. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_charging_entity: Expected: binary sensor indicating active charging. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.ev_soc_entity: Expected: current vehicle battery state of charge. Unit: %. Required.
data_description.ev_battery_capacity_kwh: Usable vehicle battery capacity. Unit: kWh. Required.
data_description.ev_target_soc: Desired state of charge at departure. Unit: %. Required.
data_description.ev_departure_time: Regular local time by which the charging target should be reached. Unit: local time. Required.
data_description.wallbox_max_power_kw: Maximum charging power available to the vehicle. Unit: kW. Required.

validation.title: Sensor validation
validation.description: The sensor assignment contains warnings. Missing entities: {missing}. Duplicate assignments: {duplicates}.

data_description.acknowledge_warnings: Confirm that you reviewed the listed warnings and want to continue with this assignment.

automation_inputs.title: Prices for automation signals
automation_inputs.description: Optional: Assign electricity price and feed-in tariff sensors. EAI never controls equipment and only exposes passive signals.

data_description.electricity_price_entity: Expected: sensor for the current import price. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: Expected: sensor for the current feed-in tariff. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.low_price_threshold_ct: Price below which EAI signals a low-price window. Unit: ct/kWh.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: License: {license_id}. Available capability level: {capability}. Forecasting is not active yet.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the entries and create the EAI configuration.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew license
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new signed EAI license key to replace the current license.

data_description.license_key: The new license key is validated locally before it is stored.

error.license_wrong_product: The license belongs to another product.
error.license_unsupported_version: The license version is not supported.
error.license_unknown_key_id: The signing key is not recognized.
error.license_not_yet_valid: The license is not valid yet.
error.license_validation_error: The license could not be validated safely.
error.validation_required: Review and accept the sensor warnings.
error.wallbox_required: Wallbox analytics require at least wallbox power and vehicle state of charge.

data_description.wp_energy_today: Expected: electrical energy meter accumulated daily since 00:00 that resets to 0 at midnight. Unit: kWh. Required during initial setup.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current outdoor air temperature at the building. Unit: °C. Required during initial setup.
data_description.indoor_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in a representative indoor or reference room. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.target_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the currently configured room target temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.operation_mode_entity: Expected: sensor with a stable text state for the operating mode, such as heating, domestic hot water, defrost, or off. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.compressor_entity: Expected: binary sensor for compressor operation (on/off) or numerical sensor using 1/0. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.dhw_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.flow_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current heating circuit flow temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.return_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current return temperature of the same heating circuit. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.starts_entity: Expected: cumulative compressor-start counter; counter resets must be detectable. Unit: count. Optional.
data_description.runtime_entity: Expected: cumulative compressor runtime counter. Unit: h. Optional.
data_description.thermal_energy_entity: Expected: cumulative heat meter for thermal energy delivered by the heat pump; the system boundary for space heating and domestic hot water must be known. Unit: thermal kWh. Optional.
data_description.volume_flow_entity: Expected: sensor for the current heating circuit volume flow; the fluid and measured circuit must be known. Unit: l/min or m³/h. Optional.
data_description.source_temp_entity: Expected: heat-source temperature sensor for outdoor air, brine, or groundwater. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.storage_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the buffer or domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.

wallbox.title: E-mobility and wallbox
wallbox.description: Update wallbox measurements and charging targets. EAI never switches the wallbox itself.

data_description.wallbox_enabled: Enables or disables all wallbox analytics and wallbox entities.
data_description.wallbox_power_entity: Expected: current charging power. Unit: W. Required when wallbox analytics are enabled.
data_description.wallbox_energy_today_entity: Expected: charging energy accumulated since midnight. Unit: kWh. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_connected_entity: Expected: binary sensor for the vehicle connection. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_charging_entity: Expected: binary sensor for active charging. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.ev_soc_entity: Expected: current vehicle state of charge. Unit: %. Required when wallbox analytics are enabled.
data_description.ev_target_soc: Desired state of charge at departure. Unit: %.
data_description.ev_departure_time: Regular local departure time. Unit: time.
data_description.wallbox_max_power_kw: Maximum available charging power. Unit: kW.

automation.title: Automation signals
automation.description: Configure optional price data for passive EAI triggers and conditions.

data_description.electricity_price_entity: Expected: sensor for the current import price. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: Expected: sensor for the current feed-in tariff. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.low_price_threshold_ct: Price below which EAI signals a low-price window. Unit: ct/kWh.
